record.question: Which of the following maps is also known as Morphographic map?
record.explanation: Morphographic mapping portrays landform shapes, also called a landform/physiographic map. It differs from a map devoted only to slope or magnetic declination. Reference: https://berniejenny.info/pdf/2015_Jenny_etal_PlanObliqueReliefForWebMaps.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
